title: Autism Rates Vary Sharply by Year, Sex, and Site
hook: One national rate hides very different measurement patterns.
closing: Raw autism rates need context because time, sex, and screening location all shape the measurement.
question: Has screening changed near you?

segments.say: Autism prevalence reached 32.2 per thousand children. The measured rate rose sharply across the recorded years.
Boys measured 49.2 per thousand. The national average hides a large difference by sex.
The California site measured 52.6 per thousand. Location adds another major source of variation to the same reported rate.
